items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I told Joe Glaser I wanted to play with Louis Armstrong. So that's the way it went.

ctx.x: Because in the late 30's Louis Armstrong fronted the Louis Russell band, didn't he?
I told Joe Glaser I wanted to play with Louis Armstrong. So that's the way it went. Lou and I were just like buddies...(!) So that's all I know.
How about Tricky Sam? How did you like his playing?
